body: DM-709 attempt 4: coverage failed once on a clean candidate (647 files/11174 tests passed, scripts/installer-nsh.test.mjs failed all 3 cases; no percentages). The deliberately minimal Windows PATH included Node and Git but omitted `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0`; that test spawns `powershell.exe`, so these were environment failures, not product regressions. No check was rerun. The corrected PATH has been preflighted with child processes resolving Node v24.22.3, Git v2.56.1, powershell.exe and PING.EXE, all exit 0. This is my setup defect; the screenshot and green PR #49 remain valid. DM-709 needs another desktop Grant retry to run only coverage with the complete PATH, then land/submit.
